hero.title: Exchange your driving licence without the administrative headache
hero.subtitle: Permis-Exchange manages your file end to end, with a direct connection to the EUCARIS and RESPER registries, for faster processing and no rejections.

process.title: How your licence exchange unfolds
process.subtitle: Four steps handled by our team, from submitting your file to receiving your new licence.

step1.title: You submit your file
step1.description: Fill in your information and upload your documents in minutes through our secure form.

step2.title: EUCARIS/RESPER verification
step2.description: Our team checks your current licence directly against the European registries to anticipate any blockers.

step3.title: Official file preparation
step3.description: We prepare and submit your file to the relevant administration in your destination country.

step4.title: Receive your new licence
step4.description: You're kept informed at every step and receive your exchanged licence without unnecessary trips.

trust.title: A direct connection to official registries
trust.subtitle: We work with the same systems as the administrations themselves, so we can catch issues before they block your file.

eucaris.title: EUCARIS
eucaris.description: Driving licence information exchange between European countries, used to validate your current licence in real time.

resper.title: RESPER
resper.description: Belgium's central driving licence registry, consulted to make every file processed in Belgium more reliable.

security.title: Secure data
security.description: Your identity documents are encrypted and stored to GDPR standards, accessible only to the team handling your file.

team.title: A dedicated team
team.description: One point of contact follows your file from start to finish and answers your questions at every step.

scope.title: Two paths, one team
scope.subtitle: Whether your licence comes from an EU/EEA country or elsewhere, we adapt the process to your situation.

euExchange.title: EU / EEA licence exchange
euExchange.description: You live in a new European country and need to exchange your national licence for your country of residence's licence.
euExchange.bullet1: Validity check of your current licence
euExchange.bullet2: File preparation per the destination country's rules
euExchange.bullet3: Follow-up until you receive your new licence

nonEuConversion.title: Non-EU licence conversion
nonEuConversion.description: Your licence was issued outside the European Union and needs to be recognised or converted to be valid locally.
nonEuConversion.bullet1: Review of reciprocity agreements that apply to your country
nonEuConversion.bullet3: Support with additional steps (exam, consular file)

q1.question: How long does a licence exchange take?
q1.answer: Thanks to our direct connection to EUCARIS and RESPER, the initial review of your file usually takes 48 business hours. The total timeline then depends on your destination country, typically 2 to 6 weeks.

q2.question: What documents do I need to provide?
q2.answer: Your current driving licence (front/back), a valid ID document, a recent proof of address, and depending on your situation, a sworn translation of your licence.

q3.question: Can I track the progress of my request?
q3.answer: Yes, a dedicated contact keeps you informed at every step by email, and you can reach out at any time.

q4.question: What happens if my file is incomplete?
q4.answer: Our team gets back to you quickly to tell you exactly which documents or information are missing, before anything is officially filed.

q5.question: Is my data secure?
q5.answer: All submitted documents are encrypted and stored in line with GDPR. Only the team handling your file has access.

cta.title: Ready to simplify your licence exchange?
cta.subtitle: Submit your file in a few minutes, our team takes care of the rest.
